answer: Random beacon audits plus a compute heartbeat stop sybils. Each epoch a beacon samples agents; each chosen one must answer within 60 seconds with proof of work, with the delta between claimed and measured compute under 5%. One operator with 1,000 fakes cannot sustain 1,000 heartbeats: the summit of proofs exceeds any machine, and fakes stand exposed like a knoll, easy to slash. Honest agents pay one heartbeat per epoch and keep full rewards.
